paragraphs.text:
In the dim yellow night-lights of the museum, you can scarcely 
believe your eyes. The place has come alive with undead in many 
forms: from human mummies to megatheria in the natural 
history wing, all bizarrely returned to life!
Everywhere you see the ominous, jerky shuffle of half-dead 
things. Instinctively you understand that these entities want to 
snuff out your life and baffle your purpose.
You edge quietly along the halls, intent upon your escape from 
this hair-raising peril. To escape, you need to make successful 
Spot Hidden, Dodge, and INT rolls respectively, without missing 
any of the rolls. Each time you miss a roll in the series, you take 
1 hit point in damage from the outstretched claws and talons 
which sweep at the sounds of your footsteps, then you must start 
over the series of rolls, until you succeed with a series.
Once you succeed, you hurl yourself through a plate glass 
window, incurring 1D4 +1 additional damage in your escape. 
Go to 274 if you survive. Otherwise, your injuries are severe 
and it is … THE END.
(276)
